posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
I'm a bit confused since you start your post by saying you used a plugin to skip title, but then you say you don't want to use any plugins at all?
Anyway, since you know the picture coordinates yourself, you can make a parallel event checking for mouse clicks (and if you want keyboard presses). Conditional
TouchInput.isPressed()
There you get
TouchInput.x
and
TouchInput.y
If you use rectangular pictures, you can just check that the x and y are in the bounds. You don't even have to make any checks if it's an opaque or transparent pixel in the image.
Then in the conditional branch if you click your 'new game' picture, you can just send the player to the first actual game play map? And if you click 'load game' picture:
SceneManager.push(Scene_Load);
